notes: Maps the frozen verifier's exact-string assertions to the script text (info_slices) that carries the same information to the agent. The covering invariant: the agent never sees instruction.md, so every reward-affecting literal the verifier checks must be reachable from the opening + info_slices.

requirements.verifier_assertion: Repo delivers packages agent, agent/tools, api client methods, and retires the --experimental flags with a clean go build ./...
must_include: a new subpackage `agent/tools` with built-in tools bash / read / edit / web_search / web_fetch

requirements.verifier_assertion: Event type constants carry the exact wire values message_delta, tool_started, run_finished, etc.
must_include: message_delta, thinking_delta, tool_call_detected, tool_started, tool_finished, compaction_started, compaction_progress, compacted, compaction_skipped, run_finished, error
one non-empty RunID that persists throughout

requirements.verifier_assertion: Registry.Names() is lexicographic, Tools() sorts by name with Type function, Execute errors 'unknown tool: <name>'.
Run rejects nil Client and empty Model with the exact messages.
must_include: agent session requires a chat client
when Format == "json", put the JSON string "json" into api.ChatRequest.Format

requirements.verifier_assertion: Budget overflow, 5xx retry, unknown-tool and round-limit messages match verbatim.
must_include: prompt is too large for the current context (~<estimate>/<window> tokens).
Your previous response caused an error: <error>
tool round limit reached after <n> rounds; send another message to continue

requirements.verifier_assertion: Approval aggregation and the no-prompter / denied Reason strings match verbatim.
must_include: Tool execution requires approval, but no approval prompter is available.
Tools that don't require approval must never trigger PromptApproval

requirements.verifier_assertion: Compaction canonical constants and helper signatures match verbatim.
Compaction trigger, window resolution, summary system prompt, and post-compaction error match.
must_include: history is still too large after compaction (~<estimate>/<window> tokens).
Summarize the archived part of an Ollama agent conversation.

requirements.verifier_assertion: api WebSearch/WebFetch request/response types with exact JSON tags and client method names.
Tool Name() values, required schema params, and web auth sentinel errors match verbatim.
must_include: Their Name() are bash, read, edit, web_search, web_fetch respectively

requirements.verifier_assertion: bash/read/edit output contracts and error strings match verbatim.
must_include: old_text matched <n> times in <path>; set replace_all to true to replace every match

requirements.verifier_assertion: web_search/web_fetch output format strings match verbatim, and self-test scope.
must_include: No content could be extracted from the page.
